body.message:
Sorry to text you on a Sunday.

I just wanted to let you know that I will be checking out tomorrow morning and  traveling out of the country.
I’m going back home due to an emergency in the family.

Since I’ll be traveling, I would really appreciate it if the security deposit could be processed and returned to me as soon as possible, as I’ll need the funds for the trip and the family emergency.

I’m sorry for the short notice and I really appreciate your understanding and help.
